SPY.title: US Futures Mixed As Street Braces For Inflation Data: Analyst Says 2024 Will Go Down As The 'Best Election Year Return Ever'
SPY.description: U.S. futures were mixed ahead of crucial inflation data. Analysts expect 2024 to be the 'best election year return ever' as the bull market continues. Key companies and ETFs mentioned include Adobe, GameStop, Rigetti Computing, Quantum Computing, and Sealsq Corp.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
